intent: To illustrate the decline in US job creation over recent decades.

requirements.question: Must the video show the full ordered decline across all six table categories, or is a general downward trend enough?
Should the 1960s-to-2000s* magnitude, 29 fewer or 96.7% lower or 3.3% share, be required, or only the trend?
Must the video explicitly mark the start of the decline in the 1970s, given the narration says the shrink begins in the early 1970s?

units.claim: US job creation declines across the decades shown, from 30 in the 1960s to 1 in the 2000s*; the series is generally downward rather than rising.
accept: Job creation falls from 30 in the 1960s to 1 in the 2000s*.
The bars step down over time: 30, 25, 18, 18, 5, then 1.
US job creation trends downward across the 1960s–2000s* decades shown.
units.evidence: All six decade bars/points appear in order with heights 30, 25, 18, 18, 5, 1; the overall direction from first to last is clearly downward.

units.claim: The endpoint decline from the 1960s to the 2000s* is 29 fewer jobs, or 96.7% lower; the 2000s* value is only 3.3% of the 1960s value.
accept: Job creation is 96.7% lower in the 2000s* than in the 1960s.
The series falls from 30 in the 1960s to 1 in the 2000s*, a drop of 29.
The 2000s* level is just 3.3% of the 1960s level.
units.evidence: The 1960s bar (30) and 2000s* bar (1) are both visible or annotated, with the computed drop or share called out.

units.claim: The decline starts after the 1960s peak: the 1970s value is 25, down 5 or 16.7% from the 1960s 30.
accept: The 1970s falls to 25, down from 30 in the 1960s.
After the 1960s peak, job creation is about 17% lower in the 1970s.
The 1970s is at 83.3% of the 1960s level.
units.evidence: The 1960s and 1970s bars are adjacent and show 30 then 25, with the 5-unit drop or 83.3% relative value visible.

optional_valid: The 2000-7* intermediate value of 5 as its own late-period bar.
The exact relative_value for any decade, such as 1970s = 0.8333, 1980s/1990s = 0.6000, or 2000-7* = 0.1667.
The 2000s* lowest-value status as a standalone annotation, if not already covered by the endpoint change.
The equal 1980s/1990s plateau as an optional aside.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
